# Puppertino

Vendored CSS modules (only trailing whitespace normalized) from https://github.com/codedgar/Puppertino
at commit `30a21ae7052b460097d153d488a0023059236a6a` (retrieved 2026-09-09).

Included modules: `dist/css/buttons.css`, `forms.css`, and `segmented-controls.css`.
MIT license, copyright Edgar Pérez. See LICENSE.

Margina uses selected button/input/select/segmented-control classes only. Its
Apple-style overrides, dark appearance, reduced effects and accessibility fixes
live in `src/panel/apple-theme.css`; no upstream JavaScript, CDN, font download,
hidden-input switch/checkbox classes, or WebGL/page capture effects are used.
